title: The Weather I Remember from 1987
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：weather　|　正文 310 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 weather 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandfather read the ① weather off the water and not off the sky, and he was right about eleven times out of twelve, which he said was not skill but habit. In 1961 the ② weather forecast came on the wireless at six, and he listened to it, went out, and did the opposite, and he was right that day too.

The ③ weather that November took the roof off eleven houses and the boat off its mooring, and he said afterwards that bad weather is not an event but a debt coming due, and no weather, he said, is ever a surprise. He went out ④ in all weathers for thirty-one years, and my grandmother said there was no virtue in it and there was no stopping it either.

In 1968 the family ⑤ weathered the worst winter anybody could remember — eleven weeks of it, no milk, no road — and my grandmother was ⑥ under the weather for most of it and would not see the doctor, and my grandfather said a woman who will not see a doctor is a woman who has decided.

He used to say you ⑦ weather the storm by going out into it, which is not advice and which I have never passed on. The ⑧ weathering of the stone at the top of the street had taken a hundred years to do what the frost of 1962 did in a week, and he pointed it out to me once and I did not care, and now I do.

The ⑨ weather, in the end, is the only thing in that village anybody talks about: everybody talks about it and nobody does anything about it, and my grandfather said that is the definition of it. The ⑩ weather I remember from 1987, the year he died, was unremarkable, and that is the remarkable thing, and I have never forgiven it.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 恶劣天气；风雨
C. v. 经受住；熬过（困难）
D. v. （使）风化；受风雨侵蚀
E. 固定搭配：under the weather 身体不适；不舒服
F. 固定搭配：weather forecast 天气预报
G. 固定搭配：in all weathers 无论天气好坏；风雨无阻
H. 固定搭配：weather the storm 渡过难关；经受住风暴

items.q: My grandfather read the weather off the water
the weather forecast came on the wireless
The weather that November took the roof
He went out in all weathers
the family weathered the worst winter
my grandmother was under the weather
you weather the storm by going out

answers.why: the weather 意为“天气”，祖父看水不看天来判断天气，十二次里有十一次是准的。
weather forecast 意为“天气预报”，1961 年天气预报六点在无线电里播出，他听完出门，反着做。
the weather 意为“恶劣天气、风雨”，那年十一月的风雨掀掉了十一栋房子的屋顶。
in all weathers 意为“无论天气好坏、风雨无阻”，他三十一年里无论天气好坏都出海。
weathered 是动词，意为“经受住、熬过”，1968 年全家熬过了记忆中最糟的那个冬天。
under the weather 意为“身体不适、不舒服”，祖母那段时间大部分时候身体不适，却不肯看医生。
weather the storm 意为“渡过难关、经受住风暴”，他常说要熬过风暴就得走进风暴里去。
weathering 意为“风化、受风雨侵蚀”，街口那块石头的风化用了一百年，而 1962 年的霜冻一周就做到了。
the weather 意为“天气”，说到底，天气是那个村子里人们唯一谈论的东西。
the weather 意为“天气”，我记得 1987 年他去世那年的天气平淡无奇，而平淡无奇本身才令人难忘。
